title: OresEdgeRouterConfig
description: Per-org edge routing contract: which subdomains exist on the org's apex domain, which origins serve each route, whether safe reads fail over or race, and how health is probed. This independently authored JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 authority must converge with an independently authored TypeSpec peer; wrangler.toml is a derived projection.

org.description: GitHub org (1:1 with this domain, the Linear project, the Supabase org, the Neon org and the GCP project).

domain.description: Apex domain owned by the org and served by Cloudflare.

linearProject.description: Linear project URL recording this routing implementation (AGENTS.md 1:1:1:1 convention).

gcpProject.description: GCP project id hosting the Cloud Run fallbacks.

statusAccess.description: Access policy for /__ores/router/status. The router liveness endpoint /__ores/router/healthz remains public.

hosts.description: Keyed by subdomain label. The canonical set is auth, org, user, api, admin, api-admin; extra labels (www, registry, web, cdn, ...) are allowed.

url.description: Scheme + host (+ optional :port) of the origin; no path.

hostHeader.description: Host header to send. Defaults to the public hostname (<label>.<domain>) so the ingress can route by host.

mode.description: proxy = fetch from origin and stream back; redirect = 302 the client to the origin; unavailable = answer a controlled JSON 503 with Retry-After.

pathPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to the request path at this origin.

paths.description: ALL paths must return 2xx for the primary to count as healthy.

failThreshold.description: Consecutive failed probes before the primary is marked down.

recoverThreshold.description: Consecutive successful probes before the primary is marked up again.

staleAfterSeconds.description: If the last probe result is older than this, treat health as unknown.

access.description: cloudflare-access requires a cryptographically verified Cloudflare Access assertion; deny returns 404.

strategy.description: failover preserves primary/fallback behavior. race concurrently calls proxy primary and fallback only for GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and uses the first non-gateway-failure response; mutation methods and WebSockets remain single-origin.

retryOnPrimaryError.description: On 502/503/504/timeout from the primary, retry idempotent requests against the fallback within the same request.
